content.title: Everything we know about 'Yellowstone' spinoff Dutton Ranch (and what's next for Beth and Rip)
content.text: Dutton Ranch is an upcoming Yellowstone spinoff centered on Kelly Reilly's Beth and Cole Hauser's Rip.The series will follow the couple as build new lives on a ranch in South Texas.Oscar nominees Ed Harris and Annette Bening round out the main cast. Beth and Rip's love story will continue on Dutton Ranch, a new Yellowstone spinoff that follows the hot-blooded couple to South Texas. The nine-episode series arrives hot on the heels of Marshals, another Yellowstone spinoff following Beth's brother, Kayce (Luke Grimes), as he embarks on a new career with the U.S. Marshals. Along with the prequels 1883 and 1923, these series represent the core of writer, director, and producer Taylor Sheridan's ever-expanding TV empire, which began with Yellowstone and has since grown to include hit shows like Tulsa King and Landman. Dutton Ranch centers on Beth Dutton (Kelly Reilly), her husband Rip Wheeler (Cole Hauser), and their ward Carter (Finn Little) as they build a life (and make a few enemies) on a ranch in South Texas. Reilly and Hauser join Sheridan as executive producers on the series, which is overseen by Chad Feehan (Lawmen: Bass Reeves). Below is everything we know about this latest Yellowstone spinoff, from its premiere date to its A-list cast, which includes a pair of Oscar nominees. What is Dutton Ranch about? Cole Hauser as Rip and Kelly Reilly as Beth on 'Dutton Ranch'. Paramount+ Dutton Ranch will pick up after the events of the Yellowstone finale, with Beth and Rip settling down on a ranch in South Texas with Carter. "As Beth and Rip fight to build a future together — far from the ghosts of Yellowstone — they collide with brutal new realities and a ruthless rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire," reads the official synopsis. "In South Texas, blood runs deeper, forgiveness is fleeting, and the cost of survival might just be your soul." Carter will also play a large role on the series, as previous teases have emphasized Beth and Rip's efforts to ensure he "becomes the man he's supposed to be." Is there a Dutton Ranch trailer? The first trailer for Dutton Ranch dropped on March 23, and it wastes no time getting into the dirt. The brief clip quite literally begins with Rip finding a corpse on what we can only assume is his land. Thrown fists, cocked guns, and flaming trailers light up the subsequent footage, which is cut with shots of new characters played by Ed Harris and Annette Bening, the latter of whom is adorned in a flamboyant Western show jacket and a wild rag neck scarf. "Welcome to Texas," Rip deadpans as he shares a drink with Beth on their porch. Later, we see Beth tell Bening's character that "a legacy is a beautiful thing... but only if it survives." Those sound like fighting words to us. Who's in the cast of Dutton Ranch? Annette Bening as Beulah on 'Dutton Ranch'. Paramount+ Reilly, Hauser, and Little will be joined by the formidable duo of Annette Bening and Ed Harris, veteran performers who hold nine Oscar nominations between them. In recent years, Bening has appeared on Peacock's Apples Never Fall (2024) and in Maggie Gyllenhaal's The Bride! (2026). On Dutton Ranch, she plays a stylish ranch owner described as powerful, cunning, and charming. Harris, meanwhile, scored an Emmy nomination for his turn on HBO's Westworld (2016–2022), and recently appeared in movies like Top Gun: Maverick (2022) and Love Lies Bleeding (2024). Here, he plays a good-humored veterinarian who's said to treat animals with compassion and understanding. The ensemble cast also includes Juan Pablo Raba (Narcos), Jai Courtney (American Primeval), J.R. Villarreal (Landman), Marc Menchaca (Dexter: Resurrection), and Natalie Alyn Lind (Big Sky). Will Dutton Reach crossover with Marshals? 'Marshals'. Sonja Flemming/CBS With Beth and Kayce each getting their own spinoffs, one might surmise that the siblings could find their way onto each other's shows. Speaking with Entertainment Weekly, though, Marshals showrunner Spencer Hudnut made it sound as if that wouldn't be happening anytime soon. "I think both shows are sort of forging their own paths right now," he said. He is, however, open to the idea. "The shows kind of exist in the same universe. If Kayce, Rip, and Beth reunited at some point, I'm sure everybody would like it," he added. "It's one of those things where we'll see what happens down the road." Is there a Dutton Ranch release date? Kelly Reilly as Beth and Ed Harris as Everett on 'Dutton Ranch'. Paramount+ Dutton Ranch will debut its first two episodes on May 15 at 8 p.m. ET/PT on the Paramount Network and Paramount+. After its two-episode premiere, the nine-episode series will air one new episode each week. Where can I watch Yellowstone? All five seasons of Yellowstone are available to stream on Peacock.
